description: This file defines the TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing termination reasons within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting termination reasons, along with input validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for CRUD operations on termination reasons, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting termination reasons, with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the service responsible for termination reason configuration operations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all termination reasons with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new termination reason.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Helper method to save a termination reason entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing termination reasons.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or multiple termination reasons.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete operation, ensuring IDs are valid and not in use.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific termination reason by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules to ensure the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing termination reason.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a termination reason, including uniqueness validation for the name.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Private helper to create validation rules for the 'name' parameter, including length and uniqueness constraints.
